'''2004 Illinois State Championship Kevin Brownell LS Massassi Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Brownell]] at [[2004 Illinois State Championship]]; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Kevin "Cubs Fan" Brownell (2004-07-19).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=33203 MBO updated post by request]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040817165232/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=33203 Internet Archive]</ref>

'''Note:''' Updated list posted "by request" (Jul 2004), not stated as the as-played Illinois States list.<ref name="src" />
